title: Proposal re. urlSync vs. custom URL params

comments.body: Thanks @olance on this one. This is very interesting, I don't have much to say on it yet because the current state of the url sync is buggy (plain buggy).
The url sync is back to "normal", however it's still an open question.
Routing is out and let you customize the URL completely. More [information in the guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/routing.html)
